summary_zh: 今日無新痛點，四項既有痛點持續：鋼價十月下半月同步上漲，壓縮獲利；出口製造業被要求提升國內附加價值、切入全球供應鏈；GRECO 2026展出人形與服務機器人，自動化需求升溫。Nike等推出零直排電動駁船，顯示出口供應鏈減碳要求正落地。勞工短缺與技能不足也列為上升痛點。
summary_en: No new pains today. Steel prices rose in late October, squeezing margins. Exporters are urged to raise local value-add in global supply chains. GRECO 2026 showcased robots as automation demand rises. Nike's zero-emission e-barge signals supply-chain decarbonisation. Labour shortage and skills gaps are rising.
